aliases.description: Other names it goes by, such as the ones merged into this venue (DUP-7); imports and searches find the venue by them.

address.description: Street address; often where you park.

pitches.description: Named pitches ("Field 3"), each with its own position.

distinctFrom.description: Venues the user said aren't the same place, so they aren't suggested as duplicates again (DUP-7).

id.description: The id from the URL; can be left out.

version.description: The version last seen, when updating. Leave it out to create the record.

description: A Venue as a client sends it to save it: the server sets updatedAt and deletedAt, and version only goes with an update.
